evidence_quotes.quote_original: The purpose of this procedure is to describe methods for managing software configuration including identifying a configuration, controlling a configuration, and reporting on the status of software configuration. This procedure applies to all developed software used for performing activities described in ENCONET d.o.o. Quality Assurance Program. This procedure affects personnel involved in the management of the software configuration.

items.statement: objective_control: Propisani su upravljanje konfiguracijom, izdavanje, promjene, auditi i pregledi.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: This procedure gives the instructions for specific activities, software release process, change control activities, audits and reviews which have to be conducted in the process of software configuration management control.

items.statement: objective_control: Baseline mora biti formalno pregledan i dogovoren; mijenja se samo kontroliranim postupkom.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: 1. Baseline – software that has been formally reviewed and agreed upon, and that can only be changed through predefined change control procedures.

items.statement: objective_control: Promjene nakon uspostave baselinea ocjenjuju se i koordiniraju.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: 2. Configuration Control – process of evaluating and coordinating changes to software after establishment of baselines.

items.criterion_name: Identification and Control of Materials, Parts, and Components
items.statement: supporting_control: Konfiguracijski elementi tretiraju se kao jedinice kontrole.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: 3. Configuration Item – a collection of hardware or software elements treated as a unit for the purpose of configuration control.

items.statement: supporting_control: Configuration Status Accounting prati razvoj entiteta i stanje projekta.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: 4. Configuration Status Accounting – the formal process of tracking software entities through the steps in their evolution that provides the lead software engineer with the data necessary to gauge and report project progress.

items.statement: objective_control: Veća revizija definirana je prepisivanjem više od 30% koda ili potpunom promjenom okruženja.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: 5. Major Revision of Existing Software – more than 30% of the source code has been rewritten or software operating environment has been completely changed.

items.statement: objective_control: Razdvojene su osobne razvojne i stabilnije projektne biblioteke.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: 6. Personal Libraries – newly created or modified versions of software entities maintained by the responsible developer.

7. Project libraries – Periodically, work products are promoted from Personal Libraries to the Project Library where access is granted to other developers or interested parties who require all or part of the promoted entity to be stable enough for their portion of the development effort.

items.statement: objective_control: Kontrola konfiguracije održava kod i dokumentaciju usklađenima s pregledanim i testiranim sadržajem.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: 8. Software Configuration Management – the process of identifying and defining the configuration items in a system, controlling the release and change of these items throughout the system life cycle, recording and reporting the status of configuration items and change requests, and verifying the completeness and correctness of Configuration Items [IEE90-a]. The basic purpose of configuration management is to control code and its associated documentation so that final code and its description are consistent and represent those items that were actually reviewed and tested.

items.statement: objective_control: Bilježe se i izvješćuju stanje elemenata i zahtjevi za promjenu.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: 4. Identifying documents that describe a Software System.

items.statement: objective_control: Definiraju se faze odobrenja promjene i novog baselinea.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: 1. Set the approval stages required to change a configuration item
and to re-baseline them.

items.statement: objective_control: Sprječavaju se neovlaštene promjene.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: 2. Prevent the unauthorized changes.

items.statement: objective_control: Potreba promjene ocjenjuje se prema učinku i potrebi ponovnog testiranja.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: 3. The need for any proposed changes to the issue should be

carefully reviewed for need versus impact (necessity of the

items.statement: objective_control: Promjena zahtjeva kontrolira promjenu dizajna i uklanjanje zastarjelog koda.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: 4. When requirements change, configuration management

items.statement: supporting_control: Baseline svakog elementa mora biti moguće zapisati i prikazati u bilo kojem trenutku.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: ### 4.2.1 After a software program or module is thoroughly reviewed and tested, it is considered baseline and is given an issue or version number.

items.statement: objective_control: Prije izdanja provjerava se potpunost dokumentacije i usklađenost s odobrenim kodom.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: ### 4.2.3 Verification that all necessary documentation has been completed and matches the code approved for release.

items.statement: objective_control: Opis verzije uključuje sadržaj i funkcionalne novosti izdanja.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: ### 4.2.4 Verification that all necessary documentation is included in Version Description Document:
1. A list of the contents.
2. A brief description of the contents.
3. A functional description of the release to inform the user of any new capabilities not included in previous releases.

items.statement: supporting_control: Opis verzije navodi prethodno otkrivene i ispravljene probleme.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: ### 4.2.4 Verification that all necessary documentation is included in Version Description Document:
4. A list of previously identified problems which have been corrected in the release.

items.statement: objective_control: Opis izdanja uključuje korisničke radnje, ograničenja i moguće probleme.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: ### 4.2.4 Verification that all necessary documentation is included in Version Description Document:

5. A discussion of special user considerations such as actions required to use the new release (updated pages of the User's Manual). Limitations or potential problems with the new release should also be discussed along with any plans to correct these limitations or problems in future releases.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: ### 4.2.4 Verification that all necessary documentation is included in Version Description Document:

items.statement: objective_control: Izdanje uključuje posebne instalacijske upute.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: ### 4.2.4 Verification that all necessary documentation is included in Version Description Document:
7. Special instructions, for installing the software on user computing systems.

items.statement: objective_control: Novi softver i veća revizija traže prošireni korisnički ili referentni priručnik.

evidence_quotes.quote_original:
4.2.5 If the release is a new software product (i.e., not a revision of existing
software) or a major revision of existing software, it is necessary to
provide more extensive documentation than that included in the Version
Description Document. This additional documentation, which is referred
to as a User's Manual or a Code Reference Manual, should describe in
much greater detail the structure of the code and the individual program
units.

items.statement: objective_control: Modeliranje fizikalnih pojava traži zaseban opis teorije koda.

evidence_quotes.quote_original:

theory underlying the actual source code should be described in a
separate document referred to as a Code Theory Manual.
